annotations.title: Bluesky profile, posts, account search or thread, live

description: Bluesky data, live and keyless: a profile with its latest posts and engagement (likes, reposts, replies, quotes), an account search, or a post thread with its replies, from the public AppView. Use it for social listening and influencer checks on Bluesky. Input: mode (profile, search_actors, thread) with actor, query or uri; optional posts, limit, depth. $0.05 per call. Returns: mode, actor, query, uri, profile{}, posts[], actors[], thread{}, post_count, actor_count, source, as_of, checked_at.

depth.description: Reply depth to flatten in thread mode, default 2.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag (en, ja, ko, pt-BR): the human-readable strings of the result (notes, details, reasons) are translated into this language; data, codes, numbers and URLs are untouched. Default: as produced.

limit.description: Accounts to return in search_actors mode, default 10.

mode.description: profile: an account and its latest posts; search_actors: accounts matching a query; thread: a post and its replies.

posts.description: Latest posts to return in profile mode, default 10.

query.description: Words to match accounts on; search_actors mode.

name: hubvibe_social_bluesky
